recap.text: Mordecai holds up an XL pet carrier with a device installed on the outside and explains that it will suck in a crawler who allows it, then break and expel them with a Bonked debuff within about ten seconds. Zhang points it at Li Na, she nods, and she disappears inside. The carrier starts buzzing, and the white cleaner bot picks it up, since its weight-based inventory takes what a personal one will not.

beats.headline: Ten seconds inside
beats.text: Prepotente examines a pet carrier and hands it to Mordecai, who holds it up for Li Na: an XL pet carrier, with some sort of device installed on the outside. Carriers cannot hold crawlers, he explains, but they can still suck one in if the crawler allows it; within about ten seconds the carrier breaks and expels them with a Bonked debuff. A carrier with a crawler in it will not go into a personal inventory, but the cleaner bot's weight-based utility inventory works. XL carriers are expensive. Zhang points it at Li Na, she nods, and she disappears inside. It starts buzzing, and the white cleaner bot picks it up.
beats.gist: Li Na climbs into an XL pet carrier, which buzzes while the white cleaner bot picks it up.

relations.note: sucked into the bot's weight-based storage before it can break
